title: Flat-Screen TV Repair for Recycling and Resale

information.value: Personal Project - Repairs from 2017 to Present
Replacement of backlight LEDs / Replacement of fuses on the power board / Replacement of faulty capacitors
Repair and refurbish non-functional TVs / Reduce electronic waste through reuse / Develop skills in electronics and maintenance

description: Since 2017, I have been working on the repair of flat-screen televisions, allowing me to develop practical skills in electronics and maintenance. Around six televisions have been repaired as part of this personal project, which I have either resold or given to family and friends, thus contributing to an eco-friendly approach by reducing electronic waste.

Most of the faults were related to the LED backlighting, where LED strips needed replacement due to failure. In other cases, I identified and repaired issues on the power board, including blown fuses and damaged capacitors.

The repaired televisions mainly came from purchases of faulty models or salvaged units, which I refurbished. This process helped me enhance my skills in electronic diagnostics, soldering, component replacement, and thermal management of electronic equipment.

Beyond repair, this project contributes to the circular economy by extending the lifespan of electronic products and reducing their environmental impact. Each repair represents an opportunity to improve my technical knowledge while giving a second life to electronic devices.
